en: Friction between your rubber shoes and the ground pushes you forward when you walk, so friction does not always slow objects down.
On the Moon, a hammer and a feather dropped at the same time hit the ground together because gravity accelerates all objects equally regardless of mass.
Magnets attract only certain metals such as iron, nickel, and cobalt, but they do not attract aluminum, copper, gold, or most other metals.
A battery does not create or supply electrons that get used up; it pushes electrons already present in the wire around a closed circuit loop.
We see a banana because light from a source bounces off the banana and enters our eyes, not because light comes out of our eyes.
Sound travels about fifteen times faster in steel than in air because particles in solids are packed closer together and pass vibrations more quickly.
An air conditioner cools a room by removing heat energy from the indoor air, because cold is not a substance that flows into objects.
A rolling ball stops because its kinetic energy transforms into heat energy through friction with the ground, not because the energy simply disappears.
A single fixed pulley does not reduce the force needed to lift an object; it only changes the direction of the force you apply.
A steering wheel is a wheel-and-axle simple machine where turning the large wheel applies greater force to the smaller axle to turn the car's wheels.
Warm air rises not because heat is lighter, but because heating makes air molecules spread apart, making warm air less dense than the cooler air around it.
A burning candle transforms chemical energy stored in wax into light energy and thermal energy, but it does not create any new energy.
